name: Window Parallax Carousel
description: Horizontal scroll-snap carousel where each slide's landscape artwork pans sideways inside its portrait frame as it crosses the scrollport, a pure CSS window parallax driven by animation-timeline: view(x).
usage:
Include styles.css, then add a
    of
  • items, each holding one landscape and an optional label; the strip scroll-snaps sideways and every image pans inside its frame as it crosses the scrollport. Tune --wpc-slide-w, --wpc-gap and --wpc-radius on the list to fit your layout.
